item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Revert “Voxel occupancy mask” 2026-08-05 Commit: 8cb6aae Reverts the previous change. It was cherry-picked from an exploration branch, and when systematically measuring the performance against the current parent commit, it performed worse in every scene. Oops. The smaller brick granularity results in more bricks being visited along the ray, which slows down rendering especially when viewing the model from afar. It performs better than the current implemention with VX_BRICK_EXT set to 4 in some scenes, so there may be merit to circle back to this idea in the future.
